purpose: Test stronger no-document factual predictors, scenario-family memorization and the exact counterfactual-instruction locator without altering the admitted candidate.

locator_diagnostic.reason_not_a_release_gate: The task explicitly asks the model to locate the paired instruction. Locatability is not a full-task shortcut unless it also recovers the factual record or proof chain.

decision_rule.if_any_inherited_factual_ceiling_fails: Build a new versioned candidate before provider testing.
decision_rule.if_all_inherited_factual_ceilings_pass: Freeze R26.14 and use Sentinel5 to determine whether the disclosed locator is empirically harmful.
